description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 17:1x) from the ROUND-1 COMPANION on MAIN-READY-32 (review/companion-r1.log: io/open.t 153/35 -> 107/23, 47 NEW rows, SHORTFALL 0 -> 58 rows never produced) and its attribution (review/attrib-ioopen.sh / .log: one-file runs on the 5e6e241d = MAIN-READY-30, a5885afc = -31 and ed8a4504 = -32 extractions ALL read 107/23 with `aborted-forms:1: PCL: local in this expression position is not supported (#3370)`) -- so NEITHER s520 batch: the regression is s519a's (MAIN-READY-29, fd04c048), whose RULED value-position refusal (#3370, DECIDED ## s519a / s520: "a `local` whose value is consumed is refused loudly") fires here.  WHY NO RUN SAW IT: s519b's harness-exception companion ran at 09:17 on its PRE-rebase tree (base fca3593b + s519b, WITHOUT s519a), and the round-level cadence deferred the next companion to this round -- #3361 DATA POINT 5 (the second regression that sat on main for a round).

THE SITE (perl 5.40.3 t/io/open.t):
    199:    ok( open(local $f, '-|', <<EOC),  'open local $f, "-|", ...' );
    210:    ok( open(local $f, '|-', <<EOC),  'open local $f, "|-", ...' );
and the SAME spelling WITHOUT a heredoc, which LOWERS and passes:
    139:    ok( open(local $f,"+>$afile"),       'open local $f, "+>", ...' );
    160-186: ok( open(local $f,'>', $afile), ...)  '>>'  '<'  '+<'
`./pl2cl --no-cache t/io/open.t` announces exactly two refusals (lines 199, 210).  So the hoist that lowers `open(local $f, ...)` as a call argument (s519a's `_lower_local_terms` / `_hoist_local_term`, now with s520b's `_word_before_local` and line-count-preserving rewrites) declines when a HereDoc token is among the arguments -- probably the term-extent / rewrite step that must keep the heredoc body attached to the statement (s520b's #3364 kept LINE COUNTS; the heredoc body is the next lines).  Probe FIRST, vs perl: `ok(open(local $f, '-|', <<EOC), 'x'); echo hi\nEOC\n` (the exact shape), `open(local $f, '<', <<EOC)` (a heredoc as a plain argument), `f(local $x = <<EOC)`, `local $x = <<EOC;` (statement level -- already right?), a heredoc BEFORE the local in the list, two heredocs.

COST: 46 passing rows lost + 58 rows never produced in perl's own io/open.t (the pipe-open block and everything after it in that form).  The companion snapshot row was spliced to 107/23 citing this task (s521), the 47 NEW rows blessed under it in baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv, and baselines/row-shortfall.tsv carries io/open.t 58 -- ALL of which LEAVE BY EDIT when this closes (expect io/open.t back to 153/35 or better in `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 io/open.t`).

FIX SHAPE: in the local-term lowering, a HereDoc argument is an ordinary term whose BODY lines follow the statement -- the hoisted statement keeps the heredoc token in place and the rewrite keeps the body attached (and the line count, #3364).  Rule 11: the one hoist path; no second heredoc special case.  Guard: a row in Pl/t/local-term-01.t with the exact `ok( open(local $f, '-|', <<EOC), ...)` shape (inverse FAILS on main ed8a4504).  A Parser2 scoping change: the sweep + corpus-diff; the companion one-file run io/open.t is the acceptance.  Scheduled: s521c member 3.


=== DONE (s521c, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18, commit b053050f, gen v2-7484) ===
_hoist_local_term no longer declines on a HereDoc: the bodies of the here-docs in the rebuilt text are appended after it, and _replace_statement_by counts lines over the new STATEMENTS' text (a body is counted from its token on both sides, #3364 kept); _token_inert_before_local treats a here-doc whose body names no variable like a double quote.  Still refused: a here-doc in a compound statement, or one followed by a newline inside the statement.  Probes = perl: the exact t/io/open.t shape (-| and |-), `f(local $x = <<EOC)`, statement-level `local $x = <<EOC;`, a here-doc BEFORE the local, two here-docs, line numbers after.  Guard Pl/t/local-term-01.t row 30 (inverse FAILS on 0b836815).  `pl2cl --no-cache t/io/open.t` announces no refusal.  Acceptance io/open.t: see the companion leg (companion --all --quick on b053050f: io/open.t 107/23 -> 153/35, parallel and serial; 18 #3512 rows out of baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv, row 129 "autoviv fh lexical aelem" back on its old cause #1710, the row-shortfall row out, the snapshot spliced).
